title: Three-Sensor Majority Voting Circuit Using NAND Gates
description: A safety monitoring system contains three sensors A, B, and C. The alarm output F must become HIGH whenever at least two of the three sensors are HIGH. Derive the Boolean expression for this condition and implement the resulting function strictly using only 2-input NAND gates (7400 ICs). Connect A, B, and C to SW0, SW1, and SW2 respectively, and route F to LED0.
author: Jarin, Tabassum
hints: Determine the input combinations for which at least two of A, B, and C are HIGH.
The majority function can be written as F = AB + AC + BC.
Use NAND gates to generate (AB)', (AC)', and (BC)' first.
Remember that the 7400 contains only 2-input NAND gates, so a three-input NAND operation must be constructed using multiple 2-input NAND gates.
